title: Build real Infinigen-Indoors kitchen for SPEAR live
objective: Generate a real Infinigen-Indoors Kitchen scene using the official Infinigen indoor generator, import it into SpearSim, cook/package it, and prepare it for spear live
instructions: Use the real Infinigen-Indoors pipeline, not a local primitive bpy scene script. Prefer infinigen_examples.generate_indoors with Kitchen room restrictions based on the local Infinigen docs/code. Do not create another cube/cylinder blockout.

Target alias/world name: infinigen_indoors_kitchen. Target Unreal map path: /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Maps/infinigen_indoors_kitchen. Target mesh dir: /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Meshes.

Generate a quality-focused kitchen scene. Avoid fast_solve.gin if feasible; use real geometry or bump/quality gin settings where compatible. If the full-quality solve is too slow or fails, preserve logs and try a pragmatic high-quality fallback, but do not silently fall back to a hand-authored primitive script.

Before Unreal import, compute Blender source stats using the available Blender binary. Reject/block if the scene is primitive-scale like the bad restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft result. Report mesh count, vertices, polygons, materials, images, lights, file size, and representative object names.
Export with higher texture bake quality than the bad r256 run. Prefer r1024; use r2048 if feasible and not excessive. If memory/time forces lower resolution, explain why.

Import into SpearSim with materials/textures and auto collision enabled. Add reasonable dim movable Unreal fixture lighting only after the real Infinigen scene is imported; do not use lighting to mask poor source asset quality.
Cook/package the target map into the active Linux package and verify both active archive and staged paks contain the target .umap and .uexp.

Run tools/spear-run live infinigen_indoors_kitchen --setting realistic-2x --dry-run after adding a temporary or durable ledger entry only if needed; if ledger/docs edits are required, report a Scribe follow-up rather than editing docs yourself.

artifacts: restaurant_kitchen_1000sqft visual gap diagnosis: generated by a custom bpy cube/cylinder script, not real Infinigen-Indoors; source scene has 235 meshes but only 2,848 vertices/1,894 polygons and flat simple materials. SPEAR import/cook succeeded, so quality issue is upstream source content plus low r256 bake/smoothing warnings.

Infinigen-Indoors can generate photorealistic residential indoor kitchens, but local inspected semantics/assets do not include restaurant/commercial kitchen support; recommended path is Infinigen layout or shell plus external photoreal commercial kitchen assets imported/assembled for Unreal/SPEAR.

expected_outputs: A real Infinigen-Indoors kitchen source scene, FBX/export artifacts, imported SPEAR map, cook/package verification, source quality metrics proving it is not primitive blockout, and a live command or ledger follow-up.
definition_of_done: The kitchen was generated through the official Infinigen-Indoors pipeline, source complexity is materially higher than the primitive restaurant/cafeteria blockouts, SPEAR import/cook/pak verification succeeds, and Tower has a command or clear next handoff for spear live.
